name: post.move
description: Moves a post to a day, keeping its time unless one is given, as a drag on the calendar does. The jobs not yet sent move with it. The same day and time changes nothing.
sql:
with p as (select * from brandbase.posts where id = :id and brand_id = :brand),
target as (select :day::date as day, coalesce(:time, p.time, '12:00') as time from p),
moved as (
  update brandbase.posts x set day = t.day, time = t.time, version = x.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from p, target t
  where x.id = p.id and (p.day is distinct from t.day or p.time is distinct from t.time)
  returning x.*
),
jobs as (
  update brandbase.post_jobs j set run_at = brandbase.instant(t.day, t.time, b.timezone), updated_at = now()
  from moved m, target t, brandbase.brands b
  where j.post_id = m.id and j.status = 'scheduled' and b.id = m.brand_id
  returning j.*
)
select brandbase.post_json(to_jsonb(m), coalesce((
  select jsonb_agg(coalesce(to_jsonb(n), to_jsonb(o)))
  from brandbase.post_jobs o left join jobs n on n.id = o.id where o.post_id = m.id), '[]')) as result
from moved m
union all
select brandbase.post_json(x) from brandbase.posts x, p where x.id = p.id and not exists (select 1 from moved)
